_comment: Balance numbers. Never hardcode any of these in logic (CLAUDE.md rule 5). M2 needs the turn clock and the AP pools; detection thresholds, vision radii, fuse lengths and charge counts arrive with M4/M5.
_minimumStep: A unit at FULL action points may always move one hex, even into terrain that costs more than its whole pool, spending everything it has. Without this a 2 AP sapper can never enter a 3 AP marsh hex, which locks two thirds of the roster out of the canal towpath approach (SPEC.md §8). Unused AP is still never banked (SPEC.md §4).
